title: A chat protocol
description:
Design and encode the messages of a small chat protocol.

```
JOIN "ada"          -> 01 03 61 64 61
SAY "hi all"        -> 02 06 68 69 20 61 6c 6c
LEAVE               -> 03
decoded: Join{ada}, Say{hi all}, Leave
unknown type 09 -> error
```
hints: `std::visit([&](const auto& m) { using T = std::decay_t<decltype(m)>; if constexpr (std::is_same_v<T, Join>) ... }, msg)` handles each kind (lesson 2.03).
Return `std::optional<Message>` from `decode`, or a struct with an error string.
requirements: One type byte, then for JOIN and SAY a 1-byte length and the text.
`std::variant<Join, Say, Leave>` as the decoded message, printed with `std::visit`.
Decoding reports an error for unknown types and short buffers.
stretch: Add a version byte at the start so the protocol can change later.
